description: This file defines the SuiteEditorConnector class which manages the selection and rendering of different HTML editors based on user preferences, including configuration and integration with TinyMCE, for use in email templates and HTML/text editing within the application.

classes.name: SuiteEditorConnector
classes.description: A connector class for managing different HTML editor types for user templates, providing methods to configure and render editors based on user preferences.

methods.name: getSuiteSettings
methods.description: Generates configuration settings for the TinyMCE editor, including event handlers and dimensions.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML output of the user-preferred editor with the appropriate settings applied.
